adapted_from.source_text:
Using the uploaded reference image of [PRODUCT], create a clean commercial catalog photograph on a seamless soft-white studio background.

Position the product upright in the center of the frame at a natural three-quarter angle. Use a large diffused softbox from the upper left and a gentle fill light from the right. Add a soft, realistic contact shadow directly beneath the product so it feels physically grounded.

Maintain neutral white balance, accurate colors, crisp edges, realistic materials, and even exposure. Keep the background minimal with generous negative space.

Preserve the exact product shape, proportions, packaging, label, logo position, colors, surface texture, and all visible details. Do not add props, text, badges, hands, decorations, or extra product features.

Professional ecommerce photography, photorealistic, sharp focus, clean retouching, 4:5 aspect ratio.
